Static Analysis静态分析

Written by Caitlin Sadowski

作者：Caitlin Sadowski

Edited by Lisa Carey

编辑：Lisa Carey

Static analysis refers to programs analyzing source code to find potential issues such as bugs, antipatterns, and other issues that can be diagnosed without executing the program. The static part specifically refers to analyzing the source code instead of a running program (referred to as dynamic analysis). Static analysis can find bugs in programs early, before they are checked in as production code. For example, static analysis can identify constant expressions that overflow, tests that are never run, or invalid format strings in logging statements that would crash when executed. However, static analysis is useful for more than just finding bugs. Through static analysis at Google, we codify best practices, help keep code current to modern API versions, and prevent or reduce technical debt. Examples of these analyses include verifying that naming conventions are upheld, flagging the use of deprecated APIs, or pointing out simpler but equivalent expressions that make code easier to read. Static analysis is also an integral tool in the API deprecation process, where it can prevent backsliding during migration of the codebase to a new API (see Chapter 22). We have also found evidence that static analysis checks can educate developers and actually prevent antipatterns from entering the codebase.

静态分析（static analysis）指的是：用程序分析源代码，以发现潜在问题，如 bug、反模式（antipattern）、以及其他无需执行程序即可诊断的问题。“静态”一词特指分析源代码、而非一个运行中的程序（后者称为“动态分析”）。静态分析可以在程序被签入为生产代码之前、尽早发现其中的 bug。例如，静态分析可以识别溢出的常量表达式、从未运行的测试、或日志语句中在执行时会崩溃的无效格式串。然而，静态分析的用处不止于找 bug。通过 Google 的静态分析，我们把最佳实践成文化、帮助代码保持到现代 API 版本、并防止或减少技术债。这类分析的例子包括：验证命名约定是否被遵守、标记对已弃用 API 的使用、或指出更简单但等价、使代码更易读的表达式。静态分析也是 API 弃用流程中不可或缺的工具，它能在代码库向新 API 迁移期间防止回退（见第 22 章）。我们还发现证据：静态分析检查能教育开发者、并实际阻止反模式进入代码库。

原书第 445 页

In this chapter, we'll look at what makes effective static analysis, some of the lessons we at Google have learned about making static analysis work, and how we implemented these best practices in our static analysis tooling and processes.

本章中，我们将考察什么造就了有效的静态分析、我们 Google 在让静态分析真正奏效方面学到的一些教训，以及我们如何在静态分析工具和流程中实现这些最佳实践。

Characteristics of Effective Static Analysis · 有效静态分析的特征

Although there have been decades of static analysis research focused on developing new analysis techniques and specific analyses, a focus on approaches for improving scalability and usability of static analysis tools has been a relatively recent development.

尽管静态分析研究已有数十年、专注于开发新的分析技术和具体分析，但对“改进静态分析工具可扩展性与可用性的方法”的关注，是相对晚近的发展。

Scalability · 可扩展性

Because modern software has become larger, analysis tools must explicitly address scaling in order to produce results in a timely manner, without slowing down the software development process. Static analysis tools at Google must scale to the size of Google's multibillion-line codebase. To do this, analysis tools are shardable and incremental. Instead of analyzing entire large projects, we focus analyses on files affected by a pending code change, and typically show analysis results only for edited files or lines. Scaling also has benefits: because our codebase is so large, there is a lot of low-hanging fruit in terms of bugs to find. In addition to making sure analysis tools can run on a large codebase, we also must scale up the number and variety of analyses available. Analysis contributions are solicited from throughout the company. Another component to static analysis scalability is ensuring the process is scalable. To do this, Google static analysis infrastructure avoids bottlenecking analysis results by showing them directly to relevant engineers.

由于现代软件已经变得更大，分析工具必须显式地应对规模化，以及时产出结果、而不拖慢软件开发流程。Google 的静态分析工具必须能扩展到 Google 数十亿行代码库的规模。为此，分析工具是可分片、增量式的。我们不是分析整个大项目，而是把分析聚焦于被一次待提交代码变更影响的文件，通常只展示被编辑文件或行的分析结果。规模化也有好处：因为我们的代码库如此之大，在可发现的 bug 方面有许多低垂果实。除了确保分析工具能在大型代码库上运行，我们还必须扩展可用分析的数量和种类。我们向全公司征集分析贡献。静态分析可扩展性的另一个组成部分，是确保流程本身可扩展。为此，Google 静态分析基础设施通过把分析结果直接展示给相关工程师，避免成为瓶颈。

Usability · 可用性

When thinking about analysis usability, it is important to consider the cost-benefit trade-off for static analysis tool users. This cost could either be in terms of developer time or code quality. Fixing a static analysis warning could introduce a bug. For code that is not being frequently modified, why fix code that is running fine in production? For example, fixing a dead code warning by adding a call to the previously dead code could result in untested (possibly buggy) code suddenly running. There is unclear benefit and potentially high cost. For this reason, we generally focus on newly introduced warnings; existing issues in otherwise working code are typically only worth highlighting (and fixing) if they are particularly important (security issues, significant bug fixes, etc.). Focusing on newly introduced warnings (or warnings on

思考分析可用性时，重要的是为静态分析工具用户考虑成本—收益权衡。这个“成本”可以是开发者时间，也可以是代码质量。修复一个静态分析警告可能引入一个 bug。对于不常被修改的代码，为什么要“修复”在生产中运行良好的代码？例如，通过向先前的死代码添加一次调用来修复死代码警告，可能导致未经测试（可能有 bug）的代码突然运行。收益不明、代价可能很高。正因如此，我们通常聚焦于新引入的警告；在其他方面正常工作的代码中，既有问题通常只在特别重要（安全问题、重要 bug 修复等）时才值得突出（和修复）。聚焦于新引入的警告（或

modified lines) also means that the developers viewing the warnings have the most relevant context on them.

被修改行上的警告），也意味着查看这些警告的开发者对它们拥有最相关的上下文。

Also, developer time is valuable! Time spent triaging analysis reports or fixing highlighted issues is weighed against the benefit provided by a particular analysis. If the analysis author can save time (e.g., by providing a fix that can be automatically applied to the code in question), the cost in the trade-off goes down. Anything that can be fixed automatically should be fixed automatically. We also try to show developers reports about issues that actually have a negative impact on code quality so that they do not waste time slogging through irrelevant results.

此外，开发者时间宝贵！花在分类分析报告或修复被突出问题上的时间，要与某个具体分析所提供的收益相权衡。如果分析作者能节省时间（例如通过提供一个可自动应用于相关代码的修复），权衡中的成本就下降。任何能自动修复的东西都应自动修复。我们也尝试向开发者展示关于那些确实对代码质量有负面影响问题的报告，好让他们不浪费时间在无关结果中跋涉。

To further reduce the cost of reviewing static analysis results, we focus on smooth developer workflow integration. A further strength of homogenizing everything in one workflow is that a dedicated tools team can update tools along with workflow and code, allowing analysis tools to evolve with the source code in tandem.

为进一步降低评审静态分析结果的成本，我们聚焦于流畅的开发者工作流集成。把一切均质化到一个工作流中的另一个优势是：一个专门的工具团队可以随工作流和代码一起更新工具，让分析工具与源代码协同演进。

We believe these choices and trade-offs that we have made in making static analyses scalable and usable arise organically from our focus on three core principles, which we formulate as lessons in the next section.

我们相信，我们在让静态分析可扩展、可用方面所做的这些选择和权衡，有机地源自我们对三条核心原则的关注，我们将在下一节把它们表述为教训。

Key Lessons in Making Static Analysis Work · 让静态分析奏效的关键教训

There are three key lessons that we have learned at Google about what makes static analysis tools work well. Let's take a look at them in the following subsections.

在 Google，关于什么让静态分析工具良好运作，我们学到了三条关键教训。我们在以下小节逐一考察。

Focus on Developer Happiness · 聚焦开发者幸福感

We mentioned some of the ways in which we try to save developer time and reduce the cost of interacting with the aforementioned static analysis tools; we also keep track of how well analysis tools are performing. If you don't measure this, you can't fix problems. We only deploy analysis tools with low false-positive rates (more on that in a minute). We also actively solicit and act on feedback from developers consuming static analysis results, in real time. Nurturing this feedback loop between static analysis tool users and tool developers creates a virtuous cycle that has built up user trust and improved our tools. User trust is extremely important for the success of static analysis tools.

我们提到了一些我们借以节省开发者时间、降低与前述静态分析工具交互成本的方式；我们也跟踪分析工具表现如何。如果不度量这一点，你就无法修复问题。我们只部署误报率低的分析工具（稍后详述）。我们还实时地主动征集并处置消费静态分析结果的开发者的反馈。培育静态分析工具用户与工具开发者之间的这个反馈环，创造了一个良性循环，建立起用户信任、改进了我们的工具。用户信任对静态分析工具的成功极其重要。

For static analysis, a false negative is when a piece of code contains an issue that the analysis tool was designed to find, but the tool misses it. A false positive occurs when a tool incorrectly flags code as having the issue. Research about static analysis tools traditionally focused on reducing false negatives; in practice, low false-positive

对静态分析而言，假阴性（false negative）指一段代码包含某分析工具本应发现的问题、但工具漏掉了它。假阳性（false positive）指工具错误地把代码标记为有该问题。关于静态分析工具的研究传统上聚焦于减少假阴性；实践中，低的假阳性

原书第 447 页

rates are often critical for developers to actually want to use a tool—who wants to wade through hundreds of false reports in search of a few true ones?

率往往对开发者“真正想用一个工具”至关重要——谁想在数百份假报告中跋涉、只为寻找少数真报告？

Furthermore, perception is a key aspect of the false-positive rate. If a static analysis tool is producing warnings that are technically correct but misinterpreted by users as false positives (e.g., due to confusing messages), users will react the same as if those warnings were in fact false positives. Similarly, warnings that are technically correct but unimportant in the grand scheme of things provoke the same reaction. We call the user-perceived false-positive rate the effective false positive rate. An issue is an effective false positive if developers did not take some positive action after seeing the issue. This means that if an analysis incorrectly reports an issue, yet the developer happily makes the fix anyway to improve code readability or maintainability, that is not an effective false positive. For example, we have a Java analysis that flags cases in which a developer calls the contains method on a hash table (which is equivalent to containsValue) when they actually meant to call containsKey—even if the developer correctly meant to check for the value, calling containsValue instead is clearer. Similarly, if an analysis reports an actual fault, yet the developer did not understand the fault and therefore took no action, that is an effective false positive.

此外，感知是假阳性率的一个关键方面。如果一个静态分析工具产生的警告在技术上正确、但被用户误解为假阳性（例如由于令人困惑的消息），用户的反应就与那些警告真是假阳性时一样。类似地，技术上正确、但在大局中不重要的警告，也激起同样的反应。我们把用户感知的假阳性率称为“有效假阳性”率。如果开发者在看到某个问题后没有采取某种积极行动，该问题就是一个“有效假阳性”。这意味着：如果一个分析错误地报告了一个问题、但开发者仍愉快地做了修复以改善代码可读性或可维护性，那它不是有效假阳性。例如，我们有一个 Java 分析，它标记这样的情形：开发者在哈希表上调用 contains 方法（等价于 containsValue），而他们本意是调用 containsKey——即便开发者确实想检查值，改调 containsValue 也更清晰。类似地，如果一个分析报告了一个真实故障、但开发者没理解该故障、因而未采取行动，那它也是有效假阳性。

Make Static Analysis a Part of the Core Developer Workflow · 让静态分析成为核心开发者工作流的一部分

At Google, we integrate static analysis into the core workflow via integration with code review tooling. Essentially all code committed at Google is reviewed before being committed; because developers are already in a change mindset when they send code for review, improvements suggested by static analysis tools can be made without too much disruption. There are other benefits to code review integration. Developers typically context switch after sending code for review, and are blocked on reviewers—there is time for analyses to run, even if they take several minutes to do so. There is also peer pressure from reviewers to address static analysis warnings. Furthermore, static analysis can save reviewer time by highlighting common issues automatically; static analysis tools help the code review process (and the reviewers) scale. Code review is a sweet spot for analysis results.

在 Google，我们通过与代码评审工具集成，把静态分析整合进核心工作流。Google 提交的几乎所有代码在提交前都要被评审；因为开发者把代码送去评审时已经处于“变更心态”，静态分析工具建议的改进可以在不太多打断的情况下被采纳。代码评审集成还有其他好处。开发者在把代码送去评审后通常会切换上下文、并被阻塞在评审者上——这正好有时间让分析运行，即便它们要花几分钟。还有来自评审者的同侪压力，促使处理静态分析警告。此外，静态分析可以通过自动突出常见问题来节省评审者时间；静态分析工具帮助代码评审流程（和评审者）规模化。代码评审是分析结果的最佳落点。

Empower Users to Contribute · 赋能用户贡献

There are many domain experts at Google whose knowledge could improve code produced. Static analysis is an opportunity to leverage expertise and apply it at scale by having domain experts write new analysis tools or individual checks within a tool.

Google 有许多领域专家，他们的知识可以改进所产出的代码。静态分析是一个利用专业知识并大规模应用它的机会：让领域专家编写新的分析工具、或一个工具内的个别检查。

原书第 448 页

For example, experts who know the context for a particular kind of configuration file can write an analyzer that checks properties of those files. In addition to domain experts, analyses are contributed by developers who discover a bug and would like to prevent the same kind of bug from reappearing anywhere else in the codebase. We focus on building a static analysis ecosystem that is easy to plug into instead of integrating a small set of existing tools. We have focused on developing simple APIs that can be used by engineers throughout Google—not just analysis or language experts—to create analyses; for example, Refaster enables writing an analyzer by specifying pre- and post-code snippets demonstrating what transformations are expected by that analyzer.

例如，了解某类配置文件上下文的专家，可以编写一个检查那些文件属性的分析器。除了领域专家之外，分析还由这样的开发者贡献：他们发现了一个 bug、并想防止同类 bug 在代码库其他任何地方重现。我们聚焦于构建一个易于接入的静态分析生态，而非集成一小撮既有工具。我们专注于开发简单 API，让全 Google 的工程师——不只是分析或语言专家——都能用来创建分析；例如，Refaster 通过指定“前—后”代码片段（展示该分析器期望做何种变换）来编写一个分析器。

Tricorder: Google's Static Analysis Platform · Tricorder：Google 的静态分析平台

Tricorder, our static analysis platform, is a core part of static analysis at Google. Tricorder came out of several failed attempts to integrate static analysis with the developer workflow at Google; the key difference between Tricorder and previous attempts was our relentless focus on having Tricorder deliver only valuable results to its users. Tricorder is integrated with the main code review tool at Google, Critique. Tricorder warnings show up on Critique's diff viewer as gray comment boxes, as demonstrated in Figure 20-1.

Tricorder，我们的静态分析平台，是 Google 静态分析的核心组成部分。Tricorder 诞生于数次把静态分析与 Google 开发者工作流集成的失败尝试；Tricorder 与先前尝试的关键区别，是我们不懈地聚焦于让 Tricorder 只向其用户交付有价值的结果。Tricorder 与 Google 主要的代码评审工具 Critique 集成。Tricorder 警告以灰色评论框的形式出现在 Critique 的 diff 查看器中，如图 20-1 所示。

原书第 449 页

To scale, Tricorder uses a microservices architecture. The Tricorder system sends analyze requests to analysis servers along with metadata about a code change. These servers can use that metadata to read the versions of the source code files in the change via a FUSE-based filesystem and can access cached build inputs and outputs. The analysis server then starts running each individual analyzer and writes the output to a storage layer; the most recent results for each category are then displayed in Critique. Because analyses sometimes take a few minutes to run, analysis servers also post status updates to let change authors and reviewers know that analyzers are running and post a completed status when they have finished. Tricorder analyzes more than 50,000 code review changes per day and is often running several analyses per second.

为扩展，Tricorder 采用微服务架构。Tricorder 系统把分析请求连同关于一次代码变更的元数据一起发给分析服务器。这些服务器可以利用该元数据，通过一个基于 FUSE 的文件系统读取该变更中源代码文件的版本，并访问缓存的构建输入和输出。分析服务器随后开始运行每个单独的分析器、并把输出写入一个存储层；每个类别的最新结果随后显示在 Critique 中。由于分析有时要跑几分钟，分析服务器还发布状态更新，让变更作者和评审者知道分析器正在运行，并在完成后发布“已完成”状态。Tricorder 每天分析超过 50,000 次代码评审变更，常常每秒运行若干次分析。

Developers throughout Google write Tricorder analyses (called analyzers) or contribute individual checks to existing analyses. There are four criteria for new Tricorder checks:

全 Google 的开发者编写 Tricorder 分析（称为“分析器”），或向既有分析贡献个别“检查”。新 Tricorder 检查有四条标准：

  • Be understandable. Be easy for any engineer to understand the output.

    可理解。输出要让任何工程师都容易理解。

  • Be actionable and easy to fix. The fix might require more time, thought, or effort than a compiler check, and the result should include guidance as to how the issue might indeed be fixed.

    可行动、易修复。修复可能比编译器检查需要更多时间、思考或努力，结果应包含关于如何确实修复该问题的指引。

  • Produce less than 10% effective false positives. Developers should feel the check is pointing out an actual issue at least 90% of the time.

    产生少于 10% 的有效假阳性。开发者应感到该检查至少在 90% 的时间里指出的是真实问题。

  • Have the potential for significant impact on code quality. The issues might not affect correctness, but developers should take them seriously and deliberately choose to fix them.

    对代码质量有显著影响的潜力。这些问题可能不影响正确性，但开发者应认真对待、并有意选择修复它们。

Tricorder analyzers report results for more than 30 languages and support a variety of analysis types. Tricorder includes more than 100 analyzers, with most being contributed from outside the Tricorder team. Seven of these analyzers are themselves plug-in systems that have hundreds of additional checks, again contributed from developers across Google. The overall effective false-positive rate is just below 5%.

Tricorder 分析器为超过 30 种语言报告结果，并支持多种分析类型。Tricorder 包含超过 100 个分析器，大多数由 Tricorder 团队之外贡献。其中 7 个分析器本身又是插件系统，带有数百个附加检查，同样由全 Google 的开发者贡献。总体有效假阳性率略低于 5%。

Integrated Tools · 集成工具

There are many different types of static analysis tools integrated with Tricorder. Error Prone and clang-tidy extend the compiler to identify AST antipatterns for Java and C++, respectively. These antipatterns could represent real bugs. For example, consider the following code snippet hashing a field f of type long:

与 Tricorder 集成的静态分析工具有许多不同类型。Error Prone 和 clang-tidy 分别扩展编译器，为 Java 和 C++ 识别 AST 反模式。这些反模式可能代表真实 bug。例如，考虑下面这段对一个 long 类型字段 f 做哈希的代码片段：

result = 31 * result + (int) (f ^ (f >>> 32));
原书第 450 页

Now consider the case in which the type of f is int. The code will still compile, but the right shift by 32 is a no-op so that f is XORed with itself and no longer affects the value produced. We fixed 31 occurrences of this bug in Google's codebase while enabling the check as a compiler error in Error Prone. There are many more such examples. AST antipatterns can also result in code readability improvements, such as removing a redundant call to .get() on a smart pointer.

现在考虑 f 的类型为 int 的情形。代码仍能编译，但右移 32 是一个 no-op，于是 f 与自身异或、不再影响所产生的值。在 Error Prone 中把该检查作为编译器错误启用时，我们在 Google 代码库中修复了 31 处这个 bug。这类例子还有更多。AST 反模式也能带来代码可读性的改进，例如移除智能指针上对 .get() 的冗余调用。

Other analyzers showcase relationships between disparate files in a corpus. The Deleted Artifact Analyzer warns if a source file is deleted that is referenced by other non-code places in the codebase (such as inside checked-in documentation). IfThisThenThat allows developers to specify that portions of two different files must be changed in tandem (and warns if they are not). Chrome's Finch analyzer runs on configuration files for A/B experiments in Chrome, highlighting common problems including not having the right approvals to launch an experiment or crosstalk with other currently running experiments that affect the same population. The Finch analyzer makes Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs) to other services in order to provide this information.

另一些分析器展示语料库中不同文件之间的关系。Deleted Artifact Analyzer 会在被代码库中其他非代码位置（例如签入文档内部）引用的源文件被删除时发出警告。IfThisThenThat 允许开发者指定两个不同文件的某些部分必须协同修改（若未协同则警告）。Chrome 的 Finch 分析器运行在 Chrome A/B 实验的配置文件上，突出常见问题，包括没有正确批准就启动实验、或与其他当前运行、影响同一人群的实验串扰。Finch 分析器向其他服务发起远程过程调用（RPC）以提供这些信息。

In addition to the source code itself, some analyzers run on other artifacts produced by that source code; many projects have enabled a binary size checker that warns when changes significantly affect a binary size.

除了源代码本身，一些分析器还运行在该源代码所产出的其他制品上；许多项目启用了一个二进制大小检查器，当变更显著影响某个二进制大小时发出警告。

Almost all analyzers are intraprocedural, meaning that the analysis results are based on code within a procedure (function). Compositional or incremental interprocedural analysis techniques are technically feasible but would require additional infrastructure investment (e.g., analyzing and storing method summaries as analyzers run).

几乎所有分析器都是过程内（intraprocedural）的，即分析结果基于一个过程（函数）内的代码。组合式或增量式的过程间（interprocedural）分析技术在技术上可行，但需要额外的基础设施投资（例如在分析器运行时分析并存储方法摘要）。

Integrated Feedback Channels · 集成的反馈渠道

As mentioned earlier, establishing a feedback loop between analysis consumers and analysis writers is critical to track and maintain developer happiness. With Tricorder, we display the option to click a Not useful button on an analysis result; this click provides the option to file a bug directly against the analyzer writer about why the result is not useful with information about analysis result prepopulated. Code reviewers can also ask change authors to address analysis results by clicking a Please fix button. The Tricorder team tracks analyzers with high Not useful click rates, particularly relative to how often reviewers ask to fix analysis results, and will disable analyzers if they don't work to address problems and improve the not useful rate.

如前所述，在分析消费者与分析作者之间建立反馈环，对跟踪和维持开发者幸福感至关重要。用 Tricorder，我们在一个分析结果上显示一个点击“无用”按钮的选项；这次点击提供了直接针对该分析器作者提交一个 bug 的选项，说明该结果为何无用，并预填关于该分析结果的信息。代码评审者也可以通过点击“请修复”按钮，要求变更作者处理分析结果。Tricorder 团队跟踪“无用”点击率高的分析器，尤其是相对于评审者要求修复分析结果的频率而言，并在分析器不解决问题、不改善“无用”率时禁用它们。

Establishing and tuning this feedback loop took a lot of work, but has paid dividends many times over in improved analysis results and a better user experience (UX)—before we established clear feedback channels, many developers would just ignore analysis results they did not understand.

建立和调优这个反馈环花了大量工作，但在改进的分析结果和更好的用户体验（UX）方面获得了数倍回报——在我们建立清晰反馈渠道之前，许多开发者只会忽略他们不理解的分析结果。

原书第 451 页

And sometimes the fix is pretty simple—such as updating the text of the message an analyzer outputs! For example, we once rolled out an Error Prone check that flagged when too many arguments were being passed to a printf-like function in Guava that accepted only %s (and no other printf specifiers). The Error Prone team received weekly Not useful bug reports claiming the analysis was incorrect because the number of format specifiers matched the number of arguments—all due to users trying to pass specifiers other than %s. After the team changed the diagnostic text to state directly that the function accepts only the %s placeholder, the influx of bug reports stopped. Improving the message produced by an analysis provides an explanation of what is wrong, why, and how to fix it exactly at the point where that is most relevant and can make the difference for developers learning something when they read the message.

有时修复相当简单——比如更新分析器输出的消息文本！例如，我们曾经推出一个 Error Prone 检查，当向 Guava 中一个只接受 %s（不接受其他 printf 说明符）的类 printf 函数传入过多参数时发出标记。Error Prone 团队每周收到“无用”bug 报告，声称该分析不正确，因为格式说明符的数量与参数数量匹配——这全都源于用户试图传入 %s 以外的说明符。在团队把诊断文本改为直接说明该函数只接受 %s 占位符后，bug 报告的涌入停止了。改进一个分析所产生的消息，能在最相关的地点，解释哪里错了、为什么、以及如何修复，并在开发者阅读消息时让他们学到东西。

Suggested Fixes · 建议的修复

Tricorder checks also, when possible, provide fixes, as shown in Figure 20-2.

Tricorder 检查在可能时也提供修复，如图 20-2 所示。

Automated fixes serve as an additional documentation source when the message is unclear and, as mentioned earlier, reduce the cost to addressing static analysis issues. Fixes can be applied directly from within Critique, or over an entire code change via a command-line tool. Although not all analyzers provide fixes, many do. We take the approach that style issues in particular should be fixed automatically; for example, by formatters that automatically reformat source code files. Google has style guides for each language that specify formatting issues; pointing out formatting errors is not a good use of a human reviewer's time. Reviewers click Please Fix thousands of times per day, and authors apply the automated fixes approximately 3,000 times per day. And Tricorder analyzers received Not useful clicks 250 times per day.

当消息不清楚时，自动修复充当额外的文档来源，并且如前所述，降低了处理静态分析问题的成本。修复可以直接从 Critique 内部应用，或通过命令行工具应用于整个代码变更。尽管并非所有分析器都提供修复，但许多提供。我们采取的做法是：风格问题尤其应被自动修复；例如通过自动重新格式化源代码文件的格式化程序。Google 为每种语言都有指定格式问题的风格指南；指出格式错误不是对人类评审者时间的好利用。评审者每天点击“请修复”数千次，作者每天大约应用自动修复 3,000 次。而 Tricorder 分析器每天收到“无用”点击 250 次。

Per-Project Customization · 按项目自定义

After we had built up a foundation of user trust by showing only high-confidence analysis results, we added the ability to run additional optional analyzers to specific projects in addition to the on-by-default ones. The Proto Best Practices analyzer is an example of an optional analyzer. This analyzer highlights potentially breaking data

在我们通过只展示高置信度分析结果、建立起用户信任的基础之后，我们增加了为特定项目运行附加“可选”分析器的能力——在默认开启的那些之外。Proto Best Practices 分析器是可选分析器的一个例子。该分析器突出潜在破坏数据

原书第 452 页

format changes to protocol buffers—Google's language-independent data serialization format. These changes are only breaking when serialized data is stored somewhere (e.g., in server logs); protocol buffers for projects that do not have stored serialized data do not need to enable the check. We have also added the ability to customize existing analyzers, although typically this customization is limited, and many checks are applied by default uniformly across the codebase.

格式对 protocol buffer（Google 与语言无关的数据序列化格式）的变更。这些变更只在序列化数据被存储到某处（例如服务器日志）时才是破坏性的；没有存储序列化数据的项目的 protocol buffer 不需要启用该检查。我们还增加了自定义既有分析器的能力，尽管这种自定义通常是受限的，许多检查默认在整个代码库中统一应用。

Some analyzers have even started as optional, improved based on user feedback, built up a large userbase, and then graduated into on-by-default status as soon as we could capitalize on the user trust we had built up. For example, we have an analyzer that suggests Java code readability improvements that typically do not actually change code behavior. Tricorder users initially worried about this analysis being too noisy, but eventually wanted more analysis results available.

一些分析器甚至一开始是可选的、基于用户反馈改进、积累起庞大用户群，然后一旦我们能利用已建立的用户信任，就毕业为默认开启状态。例如，我们有一个分析器，建议通常并不实际改变代码行为的 Java 代码可读性改进。Tricorder 用户起初担心这个分析太“吵”，但最终希望有更多分析结果可用。

The key insight to making this customization successful was to focus on project-level customization, not user-level customization. Project-level customization ensures that all team members have a consistent view of analysis results for their project and prevents situations in which one developer is trying to fix an issue while another developer introduces it.

让这种自定义成功的关键洞见，是聚焦于项目级、而非用户级自定义。项目级自定义确保所有团队成员对其项目的分析结果有一致视图，并防止“一名开发者试图修复某个问题、而另一名开发者又引入它”的情形。

Early on in the development of Tricorder, a set of relatively straightforward style checkers (linters) displayed results in Critique, and Critique provided user settings to choose the confidence level of results to display and suppress results from specific analyses. We removed all of this user customizability from Critique and immediately started getting complaints from users about annoying analysis results. Instead of reenabling customizability, we asked users why they were annoyed and found all kinds of bugs and false positives with the linters. For example, the C++ linter also ran on Objective-C files but produced incorrect, useless results. We fixed the linting infrastructure so that this would no longer happen. The HTML linter had an extremely high false-positive rate with very little useful signal and was typically suppressed from view by developers writing HTML. Because the linter was so rarely helpful, we just disabled this linter. In short, user customization resulted in hidden bugs and suppressing feedback.

在 Tricorder 开发早期，一组相对直接的风格检查器（linter）在 Critique 中显示结果，Critique 还提供用户设置，用以选择要显示结果的置信度、并屏蔽来自特定分析的结果。我们从 Critique 中移除了所有这种用户可自定义性，并立即开始收到用户关于烦人分析结果的抱怨。我们没有重新启用可自定义性，而是询问用户为什么恼火，并在 linter 中发现了各种各样的 bug 和假阳性。例如，C++ linter 也在 Objective-C 文件上运行，但产生不正确、无用的结果。我们修复了 linting 基础设施，使这不再发生。HTML linter 的假阳性率极高、有用信号极少，写 HTML 的开发者通常把它从视图中屏蔽。因为这个 linter 极少有用，我们干脆禁用了它。简而言之，用户自定义导致了隐藏的 bug 和被屏蔽的反馈。

Presubmits · Presubmit 检查

In addition to code review, there are also other workflow integration points for static analysis at Google. Because developers can choose to ignore static analysis warnings displayed in code review, Google additionally has the ability to add an analysis that blocks committing a pending code change, which we call a presubmit check. Presubmit checks include very simple customizable built-in checks on the contents or metadata of a change, such as ensuring that the commit message does not say DO NOT SUBMIT or that test files are always included with corresponding code files. Teams can also specify a suite of tests that must pass or verify that there are no Tricorder

除了代码评审，Google 的静态分析还有其他工作流集成点。由于开发者可以选择忽略代码评审中显示的静态分析警告，Google 还能添加一种阻止提交待提交代码变更的分析，我们称之为 presubmit 检查。presubmit 检查包括对一次变更内容或元数据的非常简单、可自定义的内置检查，例如确保提交消息不写着“DO NOT SUBMIT”，或测试文件总是与对应代码文件一起被包含。团队还可以指定一套必须通过的测试，或验证某个类别没有 Tricorder

原书第 453 页

issues for a particular category. Presubmits also check that code is well formatted. Presubmit checks are typically run when a developer mails out a change for review and again during the commit process, but they can be triggered on an ad hoc basis in between those points. See Chapter 23 for more details on presubmits at Google.

问题。presubmit 还检查代码格式是否良好。presubmit 检查通常在开发者把变更邮件发出评审时、以及在提交流程中再次运行，但它们也可以在这两点之间临时触发。关于 Google 的 presubmit，详见第 23 章。

Some teams have written their own custom presubmits. These are additional checks on top of the base presubmit set that add the ability to enforce higher best-practice standards than the company as a whole and add project-specific analysis. This enables new projects to have stricter best-practice guidelines than projects with large amounts of legacy code (for example). Team-specific presubmits can make the large-scale change (LSC) process (see Chapter 22) more difficult, so some are skipped for changes with CLEANUP= in the change description.

一些团队编写了自己的自定义 presubmit。这些是在基础 presubmit 集之上的附加检查，增加了强制实施比公司整体更高最佳实践标准的能力，并添加项目特定分析。这让新项目能（例如）比有大量遗留代码的项目拥有更严格的最佳实践指南。团队特定的 presubmit 可能让大规模变更（LSC）流程（见第 22 章）更困难，因此对变更描述中含 CLEANUP= 的变更会跳过其中一些。

Compiler Integration · 编译器集成

Although blocking commits with static analysis is great, it is even better to notify developers of problems even earlier in the workflow. When possible, we try to push static analysis into the compiler. Breaking the build is a warning that is not possible to ignore, but is infeasible in many cases. However, some analyses are highly mechanical and have no effective false positives. An example is Error Prone ERROR checks. These checks are all enabled in Google's Java compiler, preventing instances of the error from ever being introduced again into our codebase. Compiler checks need to be fast so that they don't slow down the build. In addition, we enforce these three criteria (similar criteria exist for the C++ compiler):

尽管用静态分析阻止提交很棒，但在工作流中更早地通知开发者问题会更好。在可能时，我们尝试把静态分析推入编译器。搞挂构建是一个无法忽略的警告，但在许多情形下不可行。然而，一些分析高度机械化、且没有有效假阳性。一个例子是 Error Prone 的 ERROR 检查。这些检查全部在 Google 的 Java 编译器中启用，防止该错误的实例再次被引入我们代码库。编译器检查必须快，好让它们不拖慢构建。此外，我们强制以下三条标准（C++ 编译器有类似标准）：

  • Actionable and easy to fix (whenever possible, the error should include a suggested fix that can be applied mechanically)

    可行动、易修复（只要可能，该错误应包含一个可机械应用的建议修复）

  • Produce no effective false positives (the analysis should never stop the build for correct code)

    不产生有效假阳性（该分析绝不应因正确代码而停止构建）

  • Report issues affecting only correctness rather than style or best practices

    只报告影响正确性的问题，而非风格或最佳实践问题

To enable a new check, we first need to clean up all instances of that problem in the codebase so that we don't break the build for existing projects just because the compiler has evolved. This also implies that the value in deploying a new compiler-based check must be high enough to warrant fixing all existing instances of it. Google has infrastructure in place for running various compilers (such as clang and javac) over the entire codebase in parallel via a cluster—as a MapReduce operation. When compilers are run in this MapReduce fashion, the static analysis checks run must produce fixes in order to automate the cleanup. After a pending code change is prepared and tested that applies the fixes across the entire codebase, we commit that change and remove all existing instances of the problem. We then turn the check on in the compiler so that no new instances of the problem can be committed without breaking the

要启用一个新检查，我们首先需要清理代码库中该问题的所有实例，好不让现有项目的构建仅仅因为编译器演进而被搞挂。这也意味着：部署一个新的基于编译器的检查，其价值必须高到值得修复它的所有既有实例。Google 有相应基础设施，通过一个集群以 MapReduce 操作的方式、在整个代码库上并行运行各种编译器（如 clang 和 javac）。当编译器以这种 MapReduce 方式运行时，所运行的静态分析检查必须产生修复，以便自动化清理。在准备并测试好一次把修复应用到整个代码库的待提交代码变更之后，我们提交该变更、移除该问题的所有既有实例。然后我们在编译器中打开该检查，使该问题的新实例不可能在不搞挂构建的情况下被提交。

原书第 454 页

build. Build breakages are caught after commit by our Continuous Integration (CI) system, or before commit by presubmit checks (see the earlier discussion).

构建破坏由我们的持续集成（CI）系统在提交后捕获，或由 presubmit 检查在提交前捕获（见前面的讨论）。

We also aim to never issue compiler warnings. We have found repeatedly that developers ignore compiler warnings. We either enable a compiler check as an error (and break the build) or don't show it in compiler output. Because the same compiler flags are used throughout the codebase, this decision is made globally. Checks that can't be made to break the build are either suppressed or shown in code review (e.g., through Tricorder). Although not every language at Google has this policy, the most frequently used ones do. Both of the Java and C++ compilers have been configured to avoid displaying compiler warnings. The Go compiler takes this to extreme; some things that other languages would consider warnings (such as unused variables or package imports) are errors in Go.

我们还力求从不发出编译器警告。我们反复发现开发者会忽略编译器警告。我们要么把一个编译器检查作为错误启用（并搞挂构建），要么不在编译器输出中显示它。由于整个代码库使用相同的编译器标志，这个决定是全局做出的。那些不能被搞挂构建的检查，要么被屏蔽、要么在代码评审中显示（例如通过 Tricorder）。尽管 Google 并非每种语言都有这个政策，但最常用的语言有。Java 和 C++ 编译器都已被配置为避免显示编译器警告。Go 编译器把这一点推向极端；其他语言认为是警告的一些东西（如未使用的变量或包导入），在 Go 中是错误。

Analysis While Editing and Browsing Code · 在编辑和浏览代码时分析

Another potential integration point for static analysis is in an integrated development environment (IDE). However, IDE analyses require quick analysis times (typically less than 1 second and ideally less than 100 ms), and so some tools are not suitable to integrate here. In addition, there is the problem of making sure the same analysis runs identically in multiple IDEs. We also note that IDEs can rise and fall in popularity (we don't mandate a single IDE); hence IDE integration tends to be messier than plugging into the review process. Code review also has specific benefits for displaying analysis results. Analyses can take into account the entire context of the change; some analyses can be inaccurate on partial code (such as a dead code analysis when a function is implemented before adding callsites). Showing analysis results in code review also means that code authors have to convince reviewers as well if they want to ignore analysis results. That said, IDE integration for suitable analyses is another great place to display static analysis results.

静态分析的另一个潜在集成点是集成开发环境（IDE）。然而，IDE 分析需要快速的分析时间（通常少于 1 秒、理想情况少于 100 毫秒），因此一些工具不适合在这里集成。此外，还有确保同一分析在多个 IDE 中一致运行的问题。我们还注意到，IDE 的流行度会起落（我们不强制使用单一 IDE）；因此 IDE 集成往往比接入评审流程更麻烦。代码评审对展示分析结果也有特定好处。分析可以考虑变更的完整上下文；一些分析在部分代码上可能不准确（例如在添加调用点之前先实现一个函数时的死代码分析）。在代码评审中展示分析结果还意味着：代码作者如果想忽略分析结果，还得说服评审者。也就是说，对合适的分析，IDE 集成是展示静态分析结果的另一个好地方。

Although we mostly focus on showing newly introduced static analysis warnings, or warnings on edited code, for some analyses, developers actually do want the ability to view analysis results over the entire codebase during code browsing. An example of this are some security analyses. Specific security teams at Google want to see a holistic view of all instances of a problem. Developers also like viewing analysis results over the codebase when planning a cleanup. In other words, there are times when showing results when code browsing is the right choice.

尽管我们主要聚焦于展示新引入的静态分析警告、或被编辑代码上的警告，但对一些分析，开发者确实想要在代码浏览期间查看整个代码库上分析结果的能力。这类例子是一些安全分析。Google 的特定安全团队想看一个问题所有实例的整体视图。开发者在计划清理时也喜欢查看代码库上的分析结果。换言之，有些时候在代码浏览时展示结果才是正确选择。

原书第 455 页

Conclusion · 小结

Static analysis can be a great tool to improve a codebase, find bugs early, and allow more expensive processes (such as human review and testing) to focus on issues that are not mechanically verifiable. By improving the scalability and usability of our static analysis infrastructure, we have made static analysis an effective component of software development at Google.

静态分析可以是改进代码库、尽早发现 bug、并让更昂贵的流程（如人类评审和测试）聚焦于不可机械验证问题的好工具。通过改进我们静态分析基础设施的可扩展性和可用性，我们已让静态分析成为 Google 软件开发中一个有效的组成部分。

TL;DRs · 本章要点

  • Focus on developer happiness. We have invested considerable effort in building feedback channels between analysis users and analysis writers in our tools, and aggressively tune analyses to reduce the number of false positives.

    聚焦开发者幸福感。我们在工具中投入大量精力建立分析用户与分析作者之间的反馈渠道，并积极调优分析以减少假阳性数量。

  • Make static analysis part of the core developer workflow. The main integration point for static analysis at Google is through code review, where analysis tools provide fixes and involve reviewers. However, we also integrate analyses at additional points (via compiler checks, gating code commits, in IDEs, and when browsing code).

    让静态分析成为核心开发者工作流的一部分。Google 静态分析的主要集成点是通过代码评审，在那里分析工具提供修复并让评审者参与。然而，我们也在其他点集成分析（通过编译器检查、把守代码提交、在 IDE 中、以及在浏览代码时）。

  • Empower users to contribute. We can scale the work we do building and maintaining analysis tools and platforms by leveraging the expertise of domain experts. Developers are continuously adding new analyses and checks that make their lives easier and our codebase better.

    赋能用户贡献。我们可以通过利用领域专家的专业知识，扩展我们构建和维护分析工具与平台的工作。开发者持续添加新的分析和检查，让他们的生活更轻松、让我们的代码库更好。
